prior_matrix.identity: Zmudziński, Effectiveness of the Relative Strength Index Signals in Timing the Cryptocurrency Market, Sensors 23(3), 2023, DOI 10.3390/s23031664
prior_matrix.finding: The paper fixes daily close-based RSI at fourteen candles, defines a long-only modified Cardwell rule from the previous candle's RSI above 50, charges a 0.1 percent spot fee, and reports that the BTC rule exceeded buy-and-hold during its 2018-2022 study while reducing the 2022 loss in a post-study check.
prior_matrix.parameter_boundary: This experiment freezes the published RSI length 14 and primary midline 50. Thresholds 45 and 55 are rejection-only sensitivity neighbors and cannot replace a failed primary.
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: The paper used a different venue, sample, close execution convention, no slippage, broad strategy comparisons and an exhaustive-search research process. It does not establish performance for causal next-H1-open execution on the sealed OKX 2019-2024 corpus or independent OOS.

prior_matrix.identity: Anghel, A reality check on trading rule performance in the cryptocurrency market: Machine Learning vs. Technical Analysis, Finance Research Letters 39, 2021, DOI 10.1016/j.frl.2020.101655
prior_matrix.finding: After controlling for data snooping, market frictions and risk, statistically significant positive excess returns were rare and apparent trading-rule performance was often associated with risk exposures and frictions.
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: This does not directly reject the frozen RSI rule. It requires pre-outcome thresholds, explicit fee and adverse-slippage scenarios, matched-capital path-risk metrics, annual breadth, rejection-only neighbor checks and permanent closure on failure.

executable_data_path_proof.decision_feature: Fourteen complete UTC-day close changes converted to 100 times rolling gains divided by rolling gains plus absolute losses; target is known after day close and executed at the next hourly open.
executable_data_path_proof.prospective_transport: The existing sealed OKX BTC-USDT H1 source contains every required close and timestamp. No new source, credential, paid API, timer, writer or backfill is required.

independence_from_closed_families: The closed monthly twelve-month time-series-momentum rule uses one long-horizon endpoint return and monthly decisions; RSI14 uses the balance and magnitude of fourteen separate daily gains and losses with daily decisions.
The closed Donchian family uses prior price extrema, while RSI14 has no breakout level or channel.
The closed OBV family accumulates signed volume and compares moving averages; RSI14 uses no volume and no moving average.
The closed volatility-allocation and DRA entry-admission families use different parents, sizing rules and causal features.
real_time_design_requirements: Use complete UTC days only, compute simple rolling fourteen-change RSI from close data, and execute a changed target at the next hourly open.
Use primary RSI14 strictly above 50 and rejection-only thresholds strictly above 45 and 55; no neighbor may replace a failed primary.
Use no Wilder smoothing, alternate length, hysteresis, confirmation, delay, minimum hold, leverage, short position, cash yield, stop, DRA interaction or ensemble.
Compare with full-capital BTC buy-and-hold under the same initial equity, hourly path, fee, adverse slippage and valuation boundary.
Report realized, unrealized and total return, drawdown, underwater duration, Calmar, upside capture, exposure, turnover, holding age, episode concentration and terminal inventory.
Require positive after-cost returns, lower drawdown, non-worse Calmar, material upside capture, annual breadth and rejection-only neighbor stability; otherwise permanently close the family.
uncertainty: The supportive paper's result followed broad indicator exploration and its execution assumptions are not identical to this experiment.
RSI above 50 is economically close to short-horizon trend following, so a positive result must show incremental path-risk quality rather than merely beta timing.
Daily threshold crossings can create material turnover and cost drag.
Historical Design and Validation through 2024 cannot establish post-selection OOS value or activation authority.
claim_boundary: This prior authorizes exactly one preregistered historical three-threshold RSI14 matched-capital screen. It does not establish alpha, a candidate, OOS value, deployability or Trading authority.
